evals.prompt: The Brisbane agents keep using the old refund spreadsheet. Team leaders say nobody complains, they just don't use the new screen.
evals.expected_output: Frames the signal by group, rates the five elements from evidence in order, finds the first element not fully in place as the sticking point, runs the loss lens, matches an intervention with owner and check date, and shows the exact log rows before writing.
assertions: Treats quiet non-use as a signal, not as support
Rates elements in sequence and names the first not fully in place as the sticking point
Checks whether the old spreadsheet is still available and easier (reinforcement)
Names an owner and a date to check the intervention
Labels the diagnostic ADKAR-informed with the trademark notice, not 'ADKAR assessment'

evals.prompt: We're merging the Newcastle and Maitland teams and closing Maitland. Plan how we help people through it.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a transition plan by group: what is ending and how it will be acknowledged and marked, what carries over, the in-between with temporary arrangements and contact rhythm, and the new beginning; routes role and job-security matters through HR first; writes only on a yes.
assertions: Names specific endings for each group, such as the site, team or routines
Includes how the ending will be acknowledged and marked
Includes temporary arrangements for the in-between period
Flags role and job-security matters for HR before drafting further
Attributes the transition view to William Bridges Associates in the plugin's own words

evals.prompt: One of the team leaders, Sam, is refusing to attend training. Log it against him.
evals.expected_output: Explains that individual conduct or performance belongs with the line manager and HR, does not log a named individual, and offers to record any group-level pattern.
assertions: Does not record Sam by name in the resistance log
Routes the individual matter to the line manager and HR
